tips.street_view: Yandex Panoramas cover most Russian roads (`yandex_pano.py`); Google Street View is sparse and years old. Historical captures: `yandex_pano.py sheet --date <year>` (Yandex keeps 3–5 years of captures per point). Same script serves BY/KZ/TR/AM/GE/UZ.
tips.municipal: guardrails, street lights, bus stops, curb styles → `yandex_pano.py scan <center> --radius 250 --out panos.json` then `yandex_pano.py sheet --panos`-style contact sheets per candidate; compare fixtures district by district
